name: projectsearch
title: ProjectSearch
description: Search project in specific folders. And open it with code, finder and terminal
author: TobiasYin

commands.name: index
commands.title: Search Project
commands.description: Search project in specific folders. And open it with code, finder and terminal

preferences.name: localOpenCmd
preferences.title: Primary Open Command
preferences.description: Command to open project (Enter). Default: code. Executes: cmd path

preferences.name: localOpenCmdSecondary
preferences.title: Secondary Open Command
preferences.description: Command to open project (Cmd+Enter). Executes: cmd path

commands.name: remote
commands.title: Search Remote Project
commands.description: Search project in remote (var ssh) specific folders. And open it with code, finder and terminal

preferences.name: projectBasePath
preferences.title: Path of the 'Remote Projects Location'
preferences.description: Path of Remote Projects, default is $HOME/Documents

preferences.name: remoteOpenCmd
preferences.title: Primary Open Command
preferences.description: Command to open remote project (Enter). Default: code. Executes: cmd --remote ssh-remote+uri path

preferences.name: prehook
preferences.title: Pre-execution Hook
preferences.description: Command to run before SSH/Remote operations (e.g. for auth)

preferences.name: showFullPath
preferences.title: show full path
preferences.description: default will show relative path of project.
